changes.text: Scale in once: add 5% of equity if a holding falls a further 15% with its thesis intact
changes.rationale: Contrarian entries are rarely at the bottom; pre-planned averaging turns early entries into an advantage

changes.text: Sell half at +25%, the rest when the narrative turns consensus-positive
changes.rationale: The edge is buying pessimism; it is gone once the crowd agrees, so harvest it

changes.text: Never buy a company with negative free cash flow and rising net debt
changes.rationale: Separates hated-but-sound from broken (the Oracle rule); value traps are the contrarian's main risk
